subtitle: Lesson 28 · Pinning every link in the chain at once

code:
stages:
  train:
    cmd: python train.py train.csv model.pkl
    deps:
      - path: data/train.csv
        md5: a1b2c3d4e5f6a7b8c9d0e1f2a3b4c5d6
    outs:
      - path: model.pkl
        md5: 1a2b3c4d5e6f7a8b9c0d1e2f3a4b5c6d
caption: Committed alongside the code — git checkout plus dvc checkout reconstruct the full input state.

eyebrow: MLflow: one run ID, every link
code:
with mlflow.start_run() as run:
    mlflow.log_param("learning_rate", 0.01)
    mlflow.log_param("random_seed", 42)
    mlflow.set_tag("git_commit", "a1b2c3d")
    mlflow.set_tag("data_version", "dvc:a1b2c3d4e5f6")
caption: A tag like "latest" is mutable — a container digest (sha256:...) is the only thing that's truly pinned.
